title: The editions are being laid out for you
headline: The publisher was waiting for your word on which edition to build; it has it now: the 3-page edition first, then the 10, laid out in the lab's look for you to review. Meanwhile synthetic read the 10-page draft as hard to please as it could: most passages pass, eighteen need a line of setup or a cut, and all three readers would cut the series page first.

for_you.ask: The series page: keep it as page 2, or move it to the back?
for_you.detail: You signed an early page on the series and its philosophy (G1). In synthetic's hardest read, all three readers (a student, a Gen X founder, a journalist) would cut it first: it delays the story. Moving it to the end of the 3- and 10-page editions keeps it and lets the story start on page 1.
for_you.recommend: Move it to the back of the short editions; keep it early in the full book.
